# SFU Library

> Simon Fraser University's library portal providing comprehensive access to academic databases, research tools, citation management, course reserves, and subject specialist support for student and faculty research needs.

SFU Library serves the Simon Fraser University community across the Lower Mainland with integrated discovery systems, remote access capabilities, and specialized research support. The library maintains extensive collections accessible through Primo and provides guidance on information literacy and research methodologies.

## Key Topics

- Library Search & Discovery
- Academic Databases
- Citation Management (Zotero, NVivo)
- Journal Articles & Research Resources
- Off-Campus Access
- Course Reserves
- Research Tools
- Liaison Librarians
- Reference Sources
- Library Catalogue
- Remote Access & MFA
- Research Assistance
- Information Literacy

## Core Search & Discovery

- [Home | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca): SFU Library homepage with access to search, resources, and services
- [SFU Library Databases](https://databases.lib.sfu.ca): Directory of academic databases accessible through SFU Library
- [Research tools | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/find/research-tools): Overview of research tools including citation and discovery resources

## Research Resources & Materials

- [Find materials by format + type | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/help/research-assistance/format-type): Research guide for finding materials by format and content type
- [Background reference sources or reference resources: Home | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/find/other-materials/reference-sources): Guide to encyclopedias, dictionaries, and reference materials
- [Search other library catalogues | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/borrow/request-materials/other-catalogues): Guide to searching BC Union Catalogue and other library systems

## Citation & Research Tools

- [Citation management software and tools | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/find/research-tools/citation-software): Guide to citation management tools including Zotero and NVivo
- [LibKey Nomad browser extension | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/find/research-tools/libkey-nomad-browser-extension): Setup guide for LibKey Nomad browser extension for journal access

## Access & Learning Support

- [Accessing online resources from off campus | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/find/research-tools/remote-access-online-resources): Instructions for off-campus access to library resources via MFA
- [Course Reserves | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/borrow/reserves): Guide to accessing course reserves and materials through Leganto
- [Library research tutorials and guides | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/help/research-assistance/tutorials): Research tutorials and learning modules on information literacy

## Research Assistance & Support

- [Liaison librarians: Contact information | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/help/research-assistance/liaison-librarians): Directory of subject specialist librarians and contact information

## Optional

- [Selected new books and other items purchased by the Library | SFU Library](https://www.lib.sfu.ca/about/overview/collections/new-books): Weekly updates on newly acquired library collection items
